name: uehaj
description: Skills by uehaj. sys1grep: grep by meaning (TypeSafe Jev) that Claude reaches for on its own instead of Grep or reading whole files, with --summarize for an answer instead of lines; /uehaj:semgrep is the older @uehaj/semgrep. run-interactive: runs rm -i, git commit -p / rebase -i or an ssh login in a herdr side pane under script, hands the keyboard to the human, and collects exit code and log when they finish. gh-issue-map: one HTML page with a table and a dependency graph of a GitHub repository's issues, PRs and commits. coordinator: one session hands issues and PRs to a few worker sessions over SendMessage, answers their questions, and manages review and merge. hatena-x-comment-refine: reads the x.com posts behind Hatena Bookmark entries in the browser (Claude in Chrome) and rewrites empty or short comments as "[tag][tag] summary", after the user approves the list.
